parameters.query:
SELECT c.id as contact_id, c.company_id, l.id as lead_id, comp.name as company_name
FROM public.contacts c
JOIN public.companies comp ON c.company_id = comp.id
LEFT JOIN public.leads l ON l.company_id = comp.id
WHERE c.normalized_email = lower(trim($1))
LIMIT 1;

parameters.name: contents

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.email_replies (
  contact_id,
  from_email,
  subject,
  body,
  provider_message_id,
  thread_id,
  classification,
  confidence_score,
  summary
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9
) ON CONFLICT (provider_message_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now()
RETURNING id;

UPDATE public.leads
SET status = 'meeting_requested',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1;

SELECT public.cancel_sequence_on_reply($2, 'meeting_requested');

INSERT INTO public.opportunities (lead_id, company_id, title, stage, deal_value, probability)
SELECT l.id, l.company_id, 'Software Development Project - ' || c.name, 'meeting_requested', 8500.00, 50
FROM public.leads l
JOIN public.companies c ON l.company_id = c.id
WHERE l.id = $1
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
